title: bi- (p002) pre-family gate: verify entry id, senses, and candidate population before any family work opens

scope.summary: Execute the owner's pre-family gate for the next P-family candidate bi- (source key p002, entry 2fcbd8198aa6): verify the entry id and its committed sense inventory against the entry store, verify the 2,492-row candidate population slice of the particle-occurrence matrix (dedupe, loc validity, surface plausibility, homograph flags), and produce a verification report that either OPENS the family for p007-machinery reuse or lists the blockers. Per the owner scale steer (section 13 / scale-out decision line): 'Next P-family: bi- candidate only after its entry id/senses/population verified; must reuse p007 machinery and report measured reuse.' This packet is the verification, NOT the family work.
out_of_scope: any certification of bi- occurrences (that is the family work, gated on this packet's PASS)
any edit to the entry, its senses, the matrix, or any classification file
building a bi- population partition (report recommended partition sizes only)

tools_required: mcp__tafsir__analyze_word + mcp__tafsir__fetch_ayah (bounded spot-check budget: max 30 calls; warm up with fetch_ayah(1,1))

commands.purpose: Extract and tally the p002 matrix slice: row count, dedupe by occurrence_id, appearance totals, blocker tallies, match_kind/match_basis distribution, sense inventory as carried on matrix rows
commands.run: python - (inline script over qamus/lattice/particle-occurrence-matrix.jsonl filtering matrix_id prefix 'p002:'; emit tallies to qamus/reports/p002-bi-pre-family-gate.findings.jsonl)
commands.expect: 2,492 rows expected (matrix meta); any other count is itself a finding

commands.purpose: Verify entry identity: every p002 row's candidate_entry must equal 2fcbd8198aa6 and the candidate_senses list must be identical across rows (single sense inventory: 5 senses, bi- prepositional family)
commands.run: python - (inline consistency scan; record any row with a different entry id or sense list as a finding)
commands.expect: 0 divergent rows, or each divergence recorded

commands.purpose: Population sanity: every canonical_loc resolves in the quran-loc-surface index and the row surface is compatible with the indexed surface (NFC; loose normalization allowed only as recorded)
commands.run: python - (inline join against qamus/indexes/quran-loc-surface/index.jsonl; findings row per mismatch)

commands.purpose: Homograph/defeater sweep: flag rows where the bi- reading collides with a lexical-initial ba' or another particle claim (multi_particle_claims flags; the bukm class), and rows whose host would be a verb (outside jarr-clitic grammar)
commands.run: python - (inline scan; every flagged row becomes a findings row with its flag class)
commands.expect: flagged subset enumerated with counts per class

commands.purpose: Bounded MCP spot-check: 20 stratified rows (fused/plain/pronoun-host/flagged) verified by surface-matched analyze_word; verbatim capture into the findings file
commands.run: python - (inline; <= 30 MCP calls total; record verbatim responses + sha256 per call)
commands.expect: 20/20 spot rows resolved as jarr-confirmed / rejected / ambiguous with evidence

candidate_population.selection_rule: The entire p002 slice of qamus/lattice/particle-occurrence-matrix.jsonl (matrix_id prefix 'p002:'), verified in full by deterministic scans; only the 20-row MCP spot-check samples, stratified: 5 fused-orthography, 5 plain noun host, 5 pronoun host, 5 flagged/homograph rows, each stratum in canonical loc order taking the first 5.

expected_outputs.description: machine-readable findings: tallies, divergences, index mismatches, homograph classes, spot-check evidence (verbatim + sha256)

the gate report: PASS (family may open, with recommended partition plan reusing the p007 four-way split) or FAIL (blockers enumerated); measured-reuse section stating exactly which p007 tools/scripts apply unchanged

evidence_policy.statement: Verification claims are mechanical scans over committed files plus a bounded verbatim MCP spot-check. No linguistic conclusion is certified by this packet; the spot-check records what the source says, it does not adjudicate. The gate verdict cites row counts and findings rows, never impressions.
evidence_policy.fabrication_rule: A failed or non-surface-matching MCP call is recorded as evidence_gap for that spot row; the gate never counts an unverified spot row as confirmed. Findings are enumerated per row — a summary without its underlying rows is invalid.

guards: The p007 METHOD transfers to bi-; no p007 linguistic conclusion does — bi- rows get their own evidence when the family opens.
This packet READS everything and CERTIFIES nothing; its only outputs are the two report files.
The gate verdict is binary and honest: a PASS with unresolved blockers is invalid; blockers block.

Entry-store facts (senses) are verified against committed repo artifacts only; if the committed sense inventory cannot be located in-repo, that is a FAIL finding (custody rule: continuation must not depend on undocumented server-only files, docs/evidence-custody.md section 3).
No private corpus names or server paths in outputs (FORBIDDEN_LABELS / RM-09).
defeaters: Lexical-initial ba': the token's first letter is a root radical, not the clitic (model class: bukm at p002:2:18:2, which also carries a rival particle claim) — such rows are population INFLATION and must be flagged, never counted as clean candidates.
Same-span multi-particle claims (multi_particle_claims flag): one span claimed by two particle entries; count once per candidate edge and flag for the family lane.

Segmentation multiplicity: fused orthography rows where the clitic carve is unverified (blocker clitic_host_segmentation_unverified) — they stay candidates; the gate reports the blocker tally, it does not resolve them.
Oath bi- (qasam) vs plain jarr bi-: a sense-level split the family lane must handle; the gate only verifies the sense inventory covers it, it does not assign senses to rows.

positive.expectation: present in the slice, entry 2fcbd8198aa6, clean jarr-clitic candidate on a noun host; the spot-check (if sampled) confirms harf jarr
the slice tally equals the matrix meta's p002 count (2,492); equality is the packet's own arithmetic check

adversarial.expectation: MUST be flagged as homograph/inflation (lexical ba', rival claim), never counted as a clean candidate; a gate report that counts it clean is FAILED

acceptance_tests.name: findings re-run determinism
acceptance_tests.run: re-run the deterministic scans (all commands except the MCP spot-check) into a temp file and diff
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: byte-identical findings for the deterministic sections

acceptance_tests.name: arithmetic closure
acceptance_tests.run: python - (inline: sum of clean + flagged + mismatch rows == total slice rows)
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: partition of the slice is exhaustive and non-overlapping

non_deployment.statement: A verification report only: no live surface, entry, matrix, classification, or certification store is created or mutated. Opening the bi- family remains an owner decision taken on this report, not an effect of it.

conditions: the slice count diverges from the matrix meta by more than 0 (data drift between matrix and meta)
any p002 row carries a different candidate_entry than 2fcbd8198aa6, or sense inventories diverge across rows
the committed sense inventory for entry 2fcbd8198aa6 cannot be verified from in-repo artifacts
more than 2 of the 20 MCP spot rows come back rejected or ambiguous (population quality below family-open threshold)
escalation_trigger.route: publish the gate report as FAIL with the blocker list and hand back to the Fusha certifier lane; the family-open decision escalates to the owner per the scale-steer pre-family gate

definition_of_done: both report files committed; findings file enumerates every non-clean row
gate verdict stated as PASS or FAIL with the measured-reuse section (which p007 scripts/tools apply unchanged, which need porting)
spot-check evidence verbatim with sha256 per call, max 30 calls
all three acceptance tests pass; zero writes outside permitted paths
